A stroke can also occur when a blood vessel in a particular part becomes blocked by an embolus. This blockage can happen when the heart suddenly stops beating, resulting in blood being trapped in an artery that was previously supplying the blockaged region. There are three types of stroke: ischemic, hemorrhagic, anoxic. An ischemic brain stroke is the most common type, accounting for 90 to 95 percent. Hemorrhagic strokes are more often seen in older patients, due to age-related changes in brain blood vessels, such as atherosclerosis. Most hemorrhaging strokes do not affect the patient's cognitive ability. However, patients who suffer an anoxia stroke may have a reduced ability to think, move, remember, recognize faces, write and speak. Some use tax is a tax on something that is consumed by a person. This is not the same as a sales tax.
In the US, there is no sales or use-tax. All goods that you purchase from someone are subject to a use or sales-rate. The sales and use rate is the amount of tax that the purchaser pays. You do not have to pay sales taxes in California, but you must pay use and sales rates. It is called an "excise tax."
The use of the term "use tax" is often used to describe a property tax, which in the UK is known as an excise (or tax) on land. However, this does not mean that a "sales tax", a UK tax for goods, is also an use (tax) tax in US. A "sale" tax refers to the tax paid when you buy a good. This tax can be paid by you, or by the person selling you the goods. When you pay your sales (use) taxes, you are paying for the use the good you bought. If you paid the sales use rates, then you will pay the taxes (excises) when the sale is completed.

"Steam engine" means a power plant that uses steam. It has a working pressure of 2,300 pounds per square inch (psig).
How does steam work inside a closed steam cycle? The cycle consists of the steam generator, the condenser, and the expansion valve.
The steam is hot and comes in contact with the cold water in the boiler. The steam pushes the water down the drain into the condensing unit. That unit is a boiler, which heats the hot water (steam) and forces it into a turbine, where it is used to drive a generator. 
If the turbine is not producing power, it must be repaired. To do that, a small amount of steam pressure is added to the pressure in a reservoir to create power. This is called "overpressure."
Some people do not have the luxury of a "steam generator" like the electric generator (a turbine and a condensable). But there is an alternative: a piston engine, or reciprocating engine. In this case, there are pistons that move up and down, pushing water up the pipes. If the piston fails, water will continue to flow, but it will take longer to get there. And the piston must have a valve, so that water can be let out. Sometimes that valve is on the outside of one of those piston engines, sometimes it's on top of it. But the engine must still work.

In a healthy individual, bilirubin is a byproduct of the breakdown of hemoglobin. In the blood, hemoglobin is converted into bilirubin.
When blood passes through the liver, it is broken down and bilirubin (a pigment) is released into the bile. When bile passes back into your intestines, the bilirubin mixes with bile acids (another pigment). The bile pigments are then excreted through your system. The total amount of bilirubin in your bloodstream is therefore the sum of your total bile pigment production and the total bilirubin excreting. This is the amount that must be excrementated from the body. 
This is an example of a balance of two forces. In this case, when bile is being excrete, there is also a counterbalance of an equal amount being produced.

text:
The Appalachean Trail This is the App-A-Lo-Cha trail. It is a hiking trail that follows the path of the original settlers who came to the area in the early 1900s. The trail goes through a variety of climbs, including the Grand Canyon. This is an amazing hike for the whole family. If you are a hiker, the trail is probably one of your favorite hikes. Here are some of my favorite pictures of this trail:
Hiking the Trail: An App A-Loch Trail Trip Sitting in a tent on the South Rim of Grand Canyon Climbing up the Mountain It is one long day hike. We hiked for 12 hours and I think we did it in 2 days. There are several huts along the way. On our way back to our car, we saw a man with a sign that said "Welcome to The Land Of The Free." It was a great feeling to see this sign. I have never felt this way when I left the country.
We also saw many people who were hiking the same trail, and were having the best time of their lives. They were smiling and laughing the entire time. Everywhere we went, people were doing the hike with others. Sometimes you have to do things for yourself, because sometimes you get to be the only one. That's the beauty of being on a trail like this. You do not have people around you. All you can do is be yourself and enjoy the scenery. When you do this, you will feel free. So many of us have become so self-conscious. Now, I know what it feels like to have nothing to think about. Enjoy it!
There is no other hiking company that hires people to hike the trails that we have. These hikers are all volunteers who have signed up to volunteer. Even the hula hoopers have a job. Their job is to take pictures, but they do it as a favor to us. Our job was to pay for their gas and food. Yes, it was expensive. But, if you take the time to enjoy yourself on your hike, your trip will be worth it.

Context effects is a very interesting concept. A very good question that I ask myself is “What is context effect?”
Let’s think about context and memory.
In many situations, I have to remember something. When I try to recall it, the context of the situation changes. For example, when I’m writing a report and I need to write something about the “weather in the week before”, I don’t know what it is. I remember that “this is the weather in week 10”, but I also remember “the weather was nice in this week”.
This is also a problem when you have a lot of things to be remembered. You remember one thing, and then you remember another one, then another. The context changes every time you are trying to retrieve the information. This is called context switching. It’ll be much more difficult to learn something if you don't know how it’d be when. Context switching makes learning harder. If you forget the first thing and you try something else, you will not remember it. What is your memory system? How does it know the memory is not the same as before? Why does this happen? Is it because of context? Or because you did not use the right part of your brain? That’ s why we call it a “memory leak”. There is more than one way to understand this.

A:
The given names are a set of four or five initials, as in John Smith, a name that is usually associated with the surname Smith.
For example, James Smith is a given-name Smith meaning "son of Smith" or "of Smith".
It is not uncommon for a person to have more than one given or surnames, with more names being associated, for example with a surname, than with one of those given. 
So it's not unusual for someone to be given a family name, and a surname, but to also have a further name with which they are associated: John Doe. The surname John may be the same as the given surname James, or it may not be. John is common, so it is often the case that the man is known as John or Jim Smith (or some variation of that name), while the woman is also known by her given family surname. However, in cases where the family names differ, the two can be mixed. This is the reason why the name Doe is sometimes used as a middle name for the father of a child, e.g. Jane Doe, Jane Smith or Jane John. It is customary to add the initial "s" to Doe to distinguish it from the other names.

A:
Read up on daylight saving time and your answer will be quite clear.
DST started in Australia and New Zealand on 1st October, 1973. It was introduced into the U.S. on 28th October 1974. 
The U of A is the first institution in the world to introduce DST. The University of California adopted DSC on 4th November, 1975. (California is considered the “first state to adopt DTS” as of 2014)
Since the United States is a “daylight saving” country, the DTW algorithm is used to calculate the time of the next day. For instance, in California, it’s the following formula: DTH + 24h (day of week) = DTT + 1h. In the USA, DTC is an abbreviation for “Dual Time Coordinated”.
In the UK, on the other hand, “Daylight Savings Time” is called “Standard Time”. The UK uses an alternative algorithm to determine the day of year. This is because, unlike the US, there is no official daylight-saving time in Great Britain. There is, however, a Daylight Saving Time Act, which governs daylight time on a day-to-day basis. Daytime is defined as between the hours of 6.00 am and 6:00 pm. During the rest of time, Day time is divided into 2-hour time-slots. These two-hours are called Standard Time, and the 2 hours after Standard time (or Day Time) are designated Day-time. On the last Sunday in May, daylight times are reset for the whole of June. From the 1 June, daytime is always 6am-6pm. But the times for Day and Night are not changed. So for example, if a person is working at 7am and going to work at 8am, they will work as usual. If they leave for work between 6-7am they work until 6pm, then they are home before 8pm and still work after 8.30pm until 11pm or 12pm (depending on whether Day or Night is longer) then go back to sleep. They wake up at 12:30am or 1pm to start again the same day and same time.

The last full week has length between Monday, March 1 and Tuesday, April 1 (or, in leap year years, between Monday March 28 and Monday April 29). A vaccine is an agent or substance used to protect a person from disease or infection.
Influenza is a type of virus that is spread through the air by droplets from infected person's coughing or sneezing. It is one of the most common respiratory infections in the world. Influenza can cause a range of symptoms, from mild to severe, such as fever, chills, headache, muscle aches, and sore throat. The symptoms of influenza vary from person to person. Even the same person may have different symptoms. For example, a child may be more sick than an adult. Most people recover from an influenza infection within two weeks, but some people may take six to 10 weeks to fully recover. Symptoms are usually mild and short-lived. However, some influenza infections can be severe and even fatal. Some people who are infected with influenza may experience a flu-like illness, which is called a "flu-type" illness. Although flu and influenza are often confused, they are not the only types of infections that can lead to flu. Fever, cold, allergies, or other conditions can also cause flu symptoms and can complicate the recovery process. Vaccines prevent the spread of viruses that cause diseases by stimulating the immune system to produce antibodies that prevent infection by the virus. A vaccine can stimulate the production of antibodies by injecting a small amount of vaccine into the body. These antibodies then help to fight off the infection and protect the person who receives the vaccine. Many different types and doses of flu vaccines are available. They are used in both children and adults. Flu vaccines also prevent some other diseases, including measles, mumps, chickenpox, rubella, polio, diphtheria, tetanus, hepatitis A, influenza, herpes, varicella zoster, pneumococcus, meningococcus and pneumococcal diseases.

Chocolate is a mixture of cocoa, sugar, milk and other ingredients. You can buy chocolate in cans, in small jars or in a box. It is made from the cocoa beans and cocoa butter, and contains milk, vanilla, sweeteners, salt and possibly other additives.
Cocoa powder is the best-known form of chocolate, but it is not the only one available. Cocoa butter is also used in chocolate. Some brands of dark chocolate are made with milk chocolate instead of with cocoa. White chocolate is pure cocoa powder. In the United States, all chocolate (not just dark) is labeled as being made exclusively from cocoa (and not from any other kind of plant, including vanilla beans). Some companies do not use pure, dark, chocolate but instead use cocoa that has been mixed with other substances, such as milk or sugar. This chocolate can also be called chocolate with added fats or cocoa mix. There are also other types of products made using cocoa and, therefore, containing milk. They are called dark-chocolate, or chocolate of some other type, for example, semisweet chocolate or nougat. These chocolate products are generally sold in the form "dark chocolate" or "semisugar" (or a similar word).
Most chocolate bars contain at least 20% cacao, which is derived from a process called "cacao bean roasting." The cocoa bean is roasted to produce a dark brown, rich, sticky mixture that is used to make chocolate bar. The prostate is a gland that is located in the lower part of the pelvis. It is made up of glandular tissue, which is essentially a bunch of cells (prostate cells) that are similar to the cells that line your body's skin.
These glands produce a fluid called the seminal fluid (seminal: semen). In men, the fluids are released in semen, and this semen is ejaculated into the urethra. The prostate also secretes prostatic fluid and a substance called mucus, both of which can be used to fertilize the eggs in a woman's womb. These glands also produce sperm, a male reproductive cell. In the male, sperm travel to a female's uterus through the vas deferens, or seminal duct. When sperm reach the egg, it is fertilized by the zygote and the developing embryo. After fertilization, two cells are produced: the embryo and an egg. They are then transferred to another woman and become a new individual. If the sperm is not fertilizing the female egg properly, she will not be able to produce an embryo; therefore, this is why it's important to make sure that sperm are healthy. Since the semen and prostate fluid are also used by women to help create babies, they are important in their reproductive system. For example, women's menstrual cycles are affected by semen. Also, men's sperm helps in fertilization of an ovum. Therefore, by looking at the size, shape, consistency, color, etc. of a man's prostate, we can tell if he's healthy or not. This is how the PSA test is performed. You can see more about this test on the link below.

What is Water Jet?
It is a general term used to describe the high-energy water flow generated when a high pressure water stream is forced into the air. Water jet engines can be used for a number of applications, including underwater propellers. The first successful waterjet was developed in the mid-1920s by German engineer Dr. Rudolf Diesel. He created the Dieselmotor, which utilized the principle of a water engine to drive a turbine. Diesels first water-jet machine, the W1, was powered by a 1,000 horsepower water turbine, and was first used on the River Seine in Paris. The W2 water plane was a more efficient waterplane (i.e. it could run on less water).
The W3 watercraft was an experimental water aircraft powered solely by water jets. It was designed by Dr Rudolf von Diesler, a German professor of aviation. In 1926, it was tested on Lake Constance. Later in 1926 it flew from Tuttlingen to Munich, flying at a speed of 200 kilometres per hour. A water driven plane flew at 100 kilometres an hour over Lake Maggiore, Italy. Von Dieslers W4 water craft was used in a 1926 test flight over the St. Lawrence River in New York. During the 1930s, von Druelen's team designed and built a jet plane, called the watercane, to demonstrate the concept. This was the first known water vehicle powered entirely by jet thrust. On April 8, 1931, this water drone was launched from the top of an airship. By 1932, Dr Paul von Lohmann's design for the jet boat was ready for testing. An experimental jet craft flew over Germany, but never reached the final design. Because of the weight of water and the required high thrust (100,500lbf), the German water vehicles were not very successful. They were plagued by problems with the control systems. Eventually, only the British Royal Navy and US Navy built jet boats.

Polyester is a material made by blending various polymers, including polystyrene, polypropylene, and polyester.
Polystyrene is the polymer of choice for most plastic packaging, such as milk cartons, plastic bags, or plastic bottles. It is often used in combination with other polymers as a plastic for food packaging and other applications. Polystyrene can be made into bottles, cans, carton blanks, films, containers, etc. The main advantage of polyster is its high impact strength. However, the main disadvantage is that the material is not biodegradable. This is why it is typically recycled after it has been used. Other materials are often added to polyesters to improve their performance and/or their impact resistance. For instance, a blend of nylon and polycarbonate (Nylon 6 and 6) can improve the impact and tear strength of the product. 
The plastic is made of a mixture of styrene, butyl, pentane, isobutylene, vinyl acetate, ethylene, di-n-butyl phthalate, glycerol, propylene glycol, triethylene glycol (TEG), and isoparaffin. TEG is usually used as the plasticizer. There are several different types of plasticizers. They can either be added or they can come from the raw material. Some of these plasticizing agents include butanol, benzene, acetone, ethanol, ethanediol, ethyl acetate (EAD), ethylene glycol monomethyl ether, glycerin, hexane (HX), isopropyl myristate and 2-methyl-2-propanol (M2P). The plastic materials can also be blended to make a compound called a "blended plastic". This compound contains a mix of different polymers and it can make the packaging stronger. A blend that contains polyvinyl chloride (PVC) is called "PVC plastic" and a PVC plastic that has a polyester resin is "PET plastic."
When a packaging material contains more than one plastic, it would be considered "polymeric" or "composite." For example, PET plastic may contain PVC and PVC may include polyamide (PA).
Note that poly-styrene and PET are not the same thing. PET is also a polymer, though it's more of an aniline-formaldehyde resin, which is used to produce the PET.

The hard palatal surface is used to make contact with the palate during speech.
 The hard tongue surface (or palatoglossus) is attached to the base of the tongue and is responsible for making contact between the tongue and the soft palate. 
I understand that the palates are attached by the pharyngeal musculature
(which is called the muscle of swallowing).
So the question is how is it that these two structures can be attached to each other? What is that attachment between them? How are they separated from eachother? I do not understand. 
A:
There is a complex arrangement of muscles that allows the jaws to open, closed, and move around. The muscles are all attached together, but are also separated by a bony septum called "the hard and soft palate". The soft and hard parts are separated from the jaw by two bony plates called pharynx and tonsils. However, the muscles and bones that control the movement of these structures are in the middle of a bone called hyoid. This hyoideus is divided into two parts, a horizontal part called sternocleidomastoid and a vertical part (the one that is not attached) called trapezius. These two bones make up the hyobasic joint, also called stapes. There are muscles in this joint and the two hyoids that allow the joint to move. It is this movement that permits speech to occur. 
You can see this by looking at the sides of your face. You see two small ridges on the cheeks called incisors. When they are closed they form the shape of an 'X' which is what the Latin word for the'stapes' is. Close them to see the incisor. Now take your finger and pull the finger back. Try it. Notice the opening of one side and closing of that side. That is why the bones are joined together and that movement allows movement. A similar movement occurs on your tongue when you eat.

Williams v, Smith, 110 Neb. 872, 198 N.W. 746 (1924). In White the court held that, to warrant an instruction on insanity for the defendant, there must be some evidence of the insanity having existed at the time of committing the offense. In Smith the rule was stated that a court may not instruct a jury on a defense unless the evidence is clear and satisfactory to justify the requested instruction. Neither of these cases supports appellant's position. The rule in White is inapplicable here because the instructions given correctly state the law in regard to the issue of intoxication and are sufficient. State in the Interest of D.A., 179 Neb., at 788, 150 Nw.2d, at 905. There is no evidence in this case that Mary was intoxicated. Similarly, the instruction given in Smith did not correctly advise the jurors that insanity could be a consideration in determining whether a defendant was legally insane. It should be noted that Smith is cited in State, ex. rel., Williams, which was decided under a different rule. Under the old rule, insanity was not a possible defense, but the new rule requires that there be evidence showing that at that time the individual was mentally ill. This is not the situation here. And, in any event, it is difficult to see how the fact of Mary's pregnancy could have been such a mental illness. As in Williams the erroneous instruction was harmless. A sales receipt is a document, issued by a business entity, that details the goods and services provided by the business.
The receipt contains the date, the names and the addresses of all the parties involved in the transaction. The receipt serves as a record of the transactions. It may also be used as proof of payment. In the event of dispute, it is evidence of what transpired. Sales receipts are a standard document in any business transaction, and a number of business entities issue them for the purpose of facilitating the sale of goods. A receipt may be issued to a buyer by way of an invoice. For example, a customer may have a purchase order, which may contain a copy of this salesreceipt. If a sale is made, then the salesperson (or a representative of that person) will issue a receipt for each item sold. This receipt will then be passed along to the customer. Once the purchase is complete, customers are requested to sign the receipt, acknowledging that they have received the merchandise. They may then proceed to pay for it. As a part of fulfilling their obligations, they may need to deposit the money into their bank account. However, if they are unable to do so, this will have to be paid by credit card, or by cash. When they do this, however, there is no guarantee that the funds will be credited to their account immediately. Some banks or credit agencies will require a confirmation from the buyer before they will receive funds. Customers who have been paying by check may find that a check has not been received in a timely manner. Even if the check is received, many banks will not be able to process it immediately, because of their processing time. There are two main reasons why a bank may not process a payment at the moment it has been made: a) The account may already be closed; and b) the bank has a back-up. Banks will open new accounts, but there will still be a problem in processing payments. Therefore, when a user is trying to make a credit, he/she needs to ensure that he has received a valid sales document.

What is new is the use of the word nonbind to describe a ruling that says the plaintiff has not proven by a preponderance of evidence that the defendant acted in a way that violates a federal statute.
What does that mean? VAT (Value Added Tax) is a tax on the value added to a product when it is sold. This tax applies to all goods and services sold in a country. VAT is paid at the point of sale by the buyer and is then deducted from the purchase price.
The amount of VAT that the seller is liable to pay depends on what goods the vendor sells. In order to calculate the amount VAT liable, the VAT rate must be known. The VAT rates are set by a rate board and are published in the relevant country’s tax laws. There are three main classes of taxes that are liable for VAT:
1) Basic rate – VAT applicable to goods of a certain value 2) Value added tax – applicable only to those goods for which VAT has been applied 3) Flat rate tax - applicable at a standard rate to every type of product or service A good is VAT-exempt when the goods are made in one country and sold abroad, or when they are bought directly from a retailer. Goods with a value above 100 Euro are VAT exempt. When goods with VAT are imported from abroad and brought into a specific country, they have to be registered at their point-of-sale. Imported goods that have already been registered are not VAT registered. Foreign-registered goods will be subject to VAT. A tax is also applied to services such as tax preparation and import duties. If a VAT registration is not available, it must also be carried out with the service provider.

This problem can be avoided by making an incision between the roots of your two first molars, so the bone between them is removed. (This method of root canal preparation is called canaloplasty.)
The root canals of molelike teeth are very small, usually less than 1⁄8 inch in diameter. Tooth roots are not as small as the size of a grain of rice. They are much smaller than a human tooth. A root should be at least 1 inch long in order to provide enough room for the nerve and blood vessels that will eventually be placed in the canal to allow the nerves to reach the brain. In order for a root to have a long enough canal, it must be drilled deep enough to accommodate the necessary amount. Therefore, the length of each root varies, depending on the specific tooth that it is in. For example, a mandibular first premolar may have an average length that is between 3 to 4 inches long. However, this may vary from tooth to tooth and from person to person. It is important to remember that a dental practitioner must measure a premolars length when planning for root preparation. When a person has a maxillary first permanent molar that has been lost, they will usually be left with an unerupted second premolon. Many people have second molar teeth that are too short to fit in a canal that was originally created for their first tooth (a mandibular premotor).
An unprepared root can cause problems with the passage of food and fluids. Unprepared roots can also cause infections and inflammation. There are several methods for preparing teeth to prevent these problems. One method is to remove the teeth and use a temporary crown to seal the opening. Another method involves removing the natural teeth, and then placing an artificial tooth in their place. Both of these methods are often used to close an open space in teeth. An alternative method uses a surgical technique called "endodontics." They are pretty much like a slow rolling wave of water. It's a little like when you make a boat trip from one end of a lake to the other. You can't just turn it around, and when the waves get to where you want to go, they are going to slow down and slow up. As they slow, you can see the water ripple across the surface. Eventually, a wave comes along and ripples the lake back up in the opposite direction. Now, the same thing happens with plate movement. When it reaches a certain speed, where the plate is coming to a stop, that is when it starts to rattle and move. This is called plate tilt. Think of it like the ocean. A big wave is moving faster than the current, so it rips through the sand and causes the wave to start moving in a different direction, which causes it to tilt and start to make rippling motions. Plate tilt is what causes tektites. Once a plate starts tilting, there is no stopping it and it continues to do so. Tectonically, this means the plates collide. So, in order for this tephra to fall, we have to have the two plates moving at a speed that was fast enough for them to collid. There was enough water in that area to cause the tilt of the world's plates. If there had not been enough, then the collision wouldn't have happened. We could not have detected the event had it not happened, because there would not be enough of an impact to move the mountain. In that case, if the earth had remained the way it is today, all we would have been able to see would be the volcanic activity on the moon and other planets that have since been destroyed. In the same way, the elements of any set are not necessarily unique. For example, a number 7 would be in every set because it would have the value 1 in all sets. Some sets are more than one, in which case the order in a particular set is irrelevant. One of these sets, called the empty set or the null set (the null set will be discussed later), consists of every object. Another set that can be used to illustrate this is called a ring, which is defined by the axiom that every number in it has an inverse. "Renaissance" is the name of a style of art that emerged in the mid-sixteenth century, and its first great exponent was Michelangelo. Renaissance is also the title of an essay by the historian David Hume, who also wrote of the first half of that century.
In English, the term Renaissance comes from the Italian Renaissance, as in Renaissance painting. In English Renaissance the Renaissance style is considered the best in art, architecture, poetry, music, drama, literature, sculpture, etc. (see Renascence).
The term "renaissance" has been used to describe the style, but is used less often in English than in other languages. For example, in French it is called renascent, while in German it's called das Renaissancetrennen, which literally means "the Renaissance of men."
Renaiscence is a noun, not a verb, so it can't be used in a sentence. It's always followed by a preposition: "in that style." The prepositions are usually: and, or, of, by, from, among, to, for, with, at, about, over, below, on, against, beside, under, between, above, before, after, around, behind, next to. The noun is always plural, like the noun Renaissance. There's no such thing as "a Renaissance man," only "men who have a Renaissance attitude towards life." 
You can also use the phrase "Renéissance" in reference to a specific style or movement, such as the Baroque, Gothic, Rococo, Barbizon, Pre-Raphaelite, Art Nouveau, Neo-classical, Modernist, Post-Modernist.

A:
addressing your question: 
 
the organic material is in the center of the display. This is how the screen works in theory, it doesn't work in practice.
The pixels are all made of a single layer of glass, but they are separated by a layer (the Organic) of organic materials. The layer is a liquid, so the liquid is between them and on top of them. 
 
 
That layer has a lower index of refraction than the surrounding glass. It allows the light to pass through the layer but is less efficient at it. The light can only pass if the lower layer isn't fully opaque. However, if it is fully transparent, the layers are in fact transparent and no light could pass. Thus, a transparent layer would be useless. To keep the pixels from completely blocking the view, an additional layer or "organic" material (which isn’t glass) is used to separate the two layers.

the scientific names of birds of the order Charadriiformes The scientific common name for birds in the family Charadridae is chough. It is also called choughs or churls. The scientific English common names for the chooks are chuft.

chuff, chuffler, bird of chaff, a churlish person, or a chattering bird. 
Chuffie is a term for a bird whose feathers and plumage are covered with white down. Chuffies are a type of featherless bird which, though not closely related to penguins and ostriches, has a similar appearance. They are usually found in warmer climates, especially in Australia and Africa. A chuffer is one who chuffs. In this context, the term can also be used to mean a person who is "chuffed" with the weather or with some aspect of life. 
A churl is an uneducated person. A "Churl" is someone who cannot speak properly, and therefore cannot hold a position of authority, which in turn causes them to be unappreciated and rejected by those around them. An example would be a school teacher who speaks with a thick accent. 
(Wikipedia)
It is not clear if the bird is related or not to the penguin, as the two species are not easily distinguished. However, they have similar flight, flapping flight and beak structure. So it is possible the name is derived from the flight of these two birds. For more information see: bird flight. (Wiki) 
 A large chook has been found near the village of Winton, County Down, Ireland, in June 2016. As of 2017, there are no sightings of this bird anywhere else in Ireland. This may be the first record of such a large bird in Northern Ireland in over two centuries. If confirmed as a new species of bird, this is believed to represent a major evolutionary event in bird evolution.

What is the difference between a state and a republic? Can a person be a citizen of both? In a democracy, the two are the same thing.
The difference is that a government that is republican is not the government of all people but rather a minority of people. For example, in a democratic republic, a majority of the people are represented. The government is made up of two branches, an executive branch and an independent legislative branch. In the case of a parliamentary republic the legislative and executive branches of government are separate. This is more akin to the executive being the head of state in the United States. A government in which there is no president (or head) is known as a direct democracy. Direct democracy is one of only two types of democracy (the others being representative and proportional).
Another difference in between the types is power. Some argue that the first is simply a more effective form of rule. It is true that it is easier for a king to control everything that he wants, but the king only controls those things he can do. He cannot do everything and he cannot even do any of it. Thus, it seems that if a ruler can control all he wishes, he will not need to rule as much as someone who has to do less. That is, you can rule and you will still have a lot of power and control over your subjects. Power, and in particular, power over the population, is what monarchies are known for. However, this does not mean that there are no other forms of leadership. You can be king without ruling over anyone, or you could be president and not be ruling. There are many other types and types that are not monarchs, so monarchia and republics are just two different ways of doing things. If you want to be considered a "king" in this context, then you need one branch of your government to have the power to make laws and another branch to execute them. No. The rules come from the data.
The rules are determined by the fact that we have a relatively small number of species and very few environments. We don’t have enough data to make many hypotheses about how the rules work, so the predictions can’’ be made on the basis of the available data and the assumptions we make about the way things are. A species is said to be in a “niche” when the conditions in which it occurs are so different from those of other species that it can survive only if it is not competing with them. This means that a species can exist in only a very restricted range of conditions. When a niche is occupied, we can predict that the species will be able to survive in the environment only in that niche. In the case of insects, the most important niche for survival is the one occupied by a host species. Most species of ants, bees, and wasps are restricted to this kind of niche, but some species, such as those in leaf litter and in rotten wood, can be found in more than one niche in their range. Another way to look at this is that some niches are more important than others. For example, insects can live in both leaf and rotten leaves, ants in all kinds of habitats, as well as on dead or decaying wood. So, while it’s true that there is a lot of variation in how insects are distributed, it seems that many of them are able of surviving in just a few nichels. But there are many more niche occupied species than niched species! This is because many nichem species live outside the niche occupied only by their host. Some species are found only on leaf or rotten leaf, some only within rotten tree, others only inside rotten trees, etc. Thus, if we look for rules of distribution, they’re not easy to find. Because the distribution of nichet species depends on a large number and variety of factors, there’‘s no obvious rule or pattern that can tell us about this. Why is there a distinction between "American Indians" and "Indians" in the first place? This is a very old question, which I don't really know the answer to. It's a bit like asking why "black" is not a racial term (or "white" as a gender term).
There are several different ways to answer this question. For the most part, there are two ways. The first is to simply say that "the term 'American Indian' is an artificial one invented to distinguish people of Indian descent from all other people, whereas the term, 'Indian', is only used to refer to people who live on or near the American Indian reservations." The second is that the terms are different because the meaning of the words is different. This answer is also very long and I think that it's worth reading.
The first question is the easiest. Here's the Wikipedia definition of "Indian":
Indian refers to the inhabitants of native North America. Most of these people are descended from those who migrated to North American shores in pre-contact times. They are classified as "Amerindians", which is derived from the Latin word "Americae", meaning "Land of America". In particular, it means people from North-Central North Carolina, South Carolina and Georgia. Although the Native American peoples that are often called "Native Americans" are mostly from South and Central America, the majority of Native Americans are North and South American. Today, Native people in North, Central, Northeast and Western parts of North/Central America are called Native Indians, while in South America they are referred to as Amerindian Indians. In Australia, some native peoples are also called Indigenous Australians. On the other hand, they have been called the "First Americans", because they were the indigenous people to America before European colonizers came. Thus, "European" means "outside Europe".

A:
This is a very good question. The answer is complex, and there is no single answer.
The xylems, or xyloglucans, are a group of long, unbranched polymers that are used to transport water, minerals, sugars, salts, enzymes and other solutes through the plant. These polymers are composed of a core of cellulose, a cell wall polymer, embedded in a complex mixture of sugars and organic acids. The fibers of the xyleme are made up of thousands of identical cells called arbuscules that run through and around the entire length of each xylemic vessel. 
Xylemic vessels are the channels that transport the water and minerals
 of roots in the soil to and from the roots. They are also the fountains of water that the plants use to regulate their internal environment. There are two types of xylemia: primary and secondary. In primary xylema the arbocules form their own channels, while in secondary xylema, the primary xylemas are surrounded by a secondary xylemma. At the end of these secondary cells there are usually two more cells that contain the lignin that surrounds the cellulose. This lignin is responsible for the mechanical strength of plant cell walls. Secondary cellulose is formed by the growth of new primary cells. Each of these secondary cell layers is called an arborescent. Sometimes a single layer of secondary arbors is referred to as a "primary cell".
Primary and arbolescent xylemes may be found in either the root system or the stem, but secondary and arborescent cells are found only in the stems. Primary xylembas may also be referred as xylical
(meaning "water") and are responsible for transporting water from root to root. It is the role of primary cell to carry water out of or into the leaf. A primary xylem can be up to two hundred feet long and up the length from a few to several hundred arbascentals. Many plants have several primary layers and a single arbranescent layer. As long as the individual cells of both layers are healthy, water will be transported from one cell layer to another. If the cells become damaged, for example by disease, bacteria, etc., the transport of that plant's water is interrupted. Once the damage occurs, it may take several years for a plant to recover.

The formal ontology of the "big fan" is very strange. It is a very different ontology from that of a person who is just a fan. But I do not think that there are too many differences between the two. If a human being is merely a mere fan, then of course there can be no "ontology" at all. We just have a set of properties, and if I say "this human is big", then there will be a property that can apply to all human beings, "human" in the sense that they are human.
If a man is really only a large fan or a small fan (or a woman, or an animal, etc.), then the set that applies to them will also apply only to those things. For example, if we consider the property of being a male human, we can say, on the one hand, that this is true for all male humans. On the other hand we also know that it is not true of all animals, for example. So in that case, the meaning of male will apply also to animals and not to human males. The Constitution of the United States of America establishes a government for the people of this nation. The basic unit of government is the federal government.
States are the units of local government in the federation. Every state is a sovereign state, independent of other states. However, the Constitution does not provide for a federal system of common law. Therefore, state law is determined by state constitutions, and is subject to the rule of law of a state. This means that states have the power to protect their citizens from the actions of their government, but also have a right to self-determination of state governments. A state may choose to have its own supreme court, however, this is not a guarantee of independence. There are several types of supreme courts. One is called the Court of Special Appeals. It is made up of judges appointed by the governor of each state who are not elected. Another is an intermediate court of appeal which is appointed and sworn to by a judge from another state and does have state-wide jurisdiction. Finally, there is what is known as the state supreme bench. These judges are appointed to fill vacancies in a particular court and are sworn in by another judge in another court. Each of these courts has jurisdiction over a certain range of cases. In addition, each court has the authority to make rules that apply to all other courts in their state or to any other state in which the court sits. 
These courts are all independent, meaning that they do not have to follow the rules of any of its fellow states or the rulings of federal courts, for example. They also are independent from federal judges.

If you are not familiar with the meaning of the electron shells, you might wonder why the above question is asked. The answer is that the shells are determined by the number of valence electrons. This is very important to understanding the nature of a compound and its properties.
Let's take a simple example:
In a metal, the electrons are more or less equally distributed between the three valence shells. In a semiconductor, however, each of these shells is associated with one or more of two electrons which are "excluded" from it. For example, in zinc, there are only two valence shell electrons, one of which is occupied by a "hole" electron, and the other is not. Hence, zinc is a very good conductor, but it is also a good semiconductor. On the contrary, silicon is an insulator, because it has a large number (four) of empty valence-shells, all of them "unoccupied" by electrons and therefore not carrying any electrical charge. (You can find a more detailed explanation in my book "The Quantum Mechanics of Solids" [Wiley, 2002].)
To see the concept of electron shell, it helps to think of it in terms of an atomic nucleus. As you move around in an atom, or in the nucleus of atoms, different parts of its structure can be occupied or empty. If we count the valence (or "core" electrons) in a nucleus, we can see that it consists of roughly the same number as the atoms in which it's located. Now, let's assume that we have two nuclei, A and B, of different numbers of "valence" and "empty" valence electron. When we move the nuclei around, they occupy different positions in space, as we would expect. Let's say that A has one empty electron (1), and that B has two empty electrons (2).
Now, to move A to B's left, lets say, is the idea that a single empty shell electron is removed from A. But then, with no "free" shell to occupy, B will have the configuration of A with two occupied empty shells (3). This means that they will be the "same" nucleus: A is now "trapped" in B. At this point, a new nucleus has been created, C, which has four empty (4) valence "shell" orbitals, so it too will contain two of each. Again, moving the two left is moving B

A:
The term mens reaque is a Latin term that means "guilty mind." A person who acts with a guilty mind is generally considered to be insane.
In insanity cases, the defense of insanity generally relies on the doctrine of mens se, which says that a person is sane if he or she is incapable of forming the required specific intent. In order to form this specific mens s ream, a defendant must have a specific, fixed intent to commit a crime. If the defendant has a fixed, specific intention, then the mental state required to establish mens r ea ce is not present. The defense is called the mens-rea re ce defense, and it can be stated as follows: "The defendant, at the time of committing the act, had a mental disease or defect rendering him or her incapable, of either (1) knowing that his or her act was wrong, or (2) having the specific criminal intent necessary for the commission of that act."
For example, if a murder defendant is found not guilty by reason of mental illness, he can assert the sanity defense. At the trial, evidence of a medical diagnosis may be presented to show that the accused was insane at or before the alleged offense. A defendant can also raise the issue of sanity by a motion for new trial. This motion must be supported by an affidavit from a doctor, with supporting evidence, setting forth the circumstances of defendant's alleged insanity. Evidence of subsequent mental conditions of an accused may also be offered in support of this defense if the facts are clear and convincing. An affidavit must show the existence of such conditions, their nature, extent, duration, treatment, diagnosis, prognosis, causal connection, etc. (See, e.g., People v. Martinez (2003)
107 Cal.App.4th 971, 982-983, 132 Cal Rptr.2d 905).
If the evidence is sufficient to support a finding of lack of criminal responsibility, defendant may seek to have the jury instructed that if they find he was not insane, they must return a verdict of not true. Alternatively, in such a case, it is the court's duty to instruct the jurors as to the nature of their obligation to acquit if it finds that defendant was sane at time the crime was committed. A:
addressing the first part of your question: yes, UA is able to detect UEs in RACH (or any other mode), and it can detect these signals in various ways.
For example, in UTRAN, the UE has a dedicated control channel that it uses to inform the eNodeB when it is ready to be handed over to the network. In GSM, there is a special control-channel called the paging channel, which is used to notify the user that he can call the cell. This is not true in LTE, because LTE only has one control and user channels (see this question and this blog post for details).
So, it's not the case that UA only detects UIs in an RRC_INIT (that is, R1) or R3 state. It can, however, detect them in other states, depending on the signaling scheme used. I will address the second part, and show you how UA can do so. But first, let's understand what the "detection" really means. 
When a UE is in UE_IDLE state, then it does not have any active traffic (for example a voice call, or data session for an Internet connection). If it has data traffic, this traffic is sent to a neighbor cell (in the URA-RACH or UTRA-MBSFN signaling schemes). The neighbor can then send a pager message to it (by using paged control channels, e.g., the primary control message from the serving network or the secondary control messages from neighboring cells). In other words, UAs detect traffic in this state by using the control signaling. The traffic can be received by the UA, but it cannot be sent. If the neighbor UA detects a traffic from this UE, a handover message is then sent (via the traffic channel) to this neighbor UE. When this message reaches the destination UE in response, traffic will be exchanged between the two UUs. For example if the source UA detected traffic on its pagers and the target UA does nothing, they will exchange traffic until the handovers occur. Or, if this UA did not detect any traffic but the other UA was detecting traffic by means of pages, that other UE will receive traffic.

Human sperm is composed of two components: a fluid outer coat called “cumulus cells” and a protein-rich inner layer called the “zona pellucida”. The zona is a small membrane-like structure which surrounds the sperm and is responsible for the release of sperm from the female reproductive tract, and also for fertilization.
The fluid coat is made of a mixture of water, lipids, electrolytes, proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins, anti-oxidants, hormones, antibodies and other elements. The fluid coats the surface of the spermatozoa, protecting them from various external threats. Spermatozoa are not only protected from outside threats, but also from inside threats which are the most common in the male reproductive system. These are:
– Chemicals and physical agents which can be used by the body to destroy or kill the cells Sperm cells can withstand a lot of damage, for example, when the cell is damaged by a chemical or physical agent, the DNA in it is protected by histones. It is the histone that binds with other proteins and prevents the protein from breaking down. If the binding is broken, it can result in cancer or death. In this way, sperm cells, which were damaged in a natural way are now protected. Also, damaged sperm can have their DNA damaged, so the chromosomes are no longer able to pass on their information to the next generation. As a result, a baby is born with a genetically damaged chromosome. This causes a serious problem when trying to have children. However, because of this protection, human sperm have a very long life span. Even after fertilization, they are able for up to 40 years, after which time the level of DNA damage increases and the ability to fertilize decreases. Therefore, there is no need for artificial insemination. That is why there are many people who can’t have kids. They are unable to get pregnant or have any success at it. For this reason, artificial fertilization is also not used in assisted reproduction. Only in rare cases, such as in cases of severe male infertility, is it used to produce healthy children after several years of infertility treatment.

During the flight, Luna completed its orbit of the Earth and then began a parabolic flight around the Sun. As it approached the near side of Earth's orbit, it would gradually turn in toward the lunar surface. Once at the surface, Lunas engines would be switched off and its solar panels would turn off, so that it could use its remaining power to stay in orbit. This was done to minimize the effect of radiation on its electronics and sensors, as well as to ensure that the spacecraft would not be damaged by the intense radiation of its approach. In a general sense, a “motion to take no further action” is a polite way of saying “we’re going to let this thing die as we go along.” It’s a way to say “let this issue go away for now, because we’ve got bigger issues on our plate right now.”
But that’d be a pretty bad idea. The motion to “take no action,” which can be as simple as “I’m not going forward with this,” is an official statement of “this is just a stupid idea I don’t want to see happen, so I’ll just stop trying to talk about it.” That’se two very different things.
The motion “no further discussion,” however, is pretty much an expression of the view that you should just drop the issue. It suggests that the other person is simply being disingenuous, or has no interest in the conversation at all. That would be fine if it were just about an issue that was clearly doomed, but it’ss not. If you’r talking about a complex and important topic, and the person you are talking to just doesn’ts care, that is not a good sign. At all!
A motion that says “please don”t bring this up again” or “if you bring it up, I won’ t respond to you” means that your interlocutor is deliberately making the topic more difficult to discuss, intentionally making it more important for the discussion to end. You have to be careful not to interpret that as the same as saying, “stop asking me about this.” If a person says to me, in a clear and direct way, to stop talking, they don‘t just mean that they want me to shut up; they mean they have no intention of continuing the dialogue. They are not interested in what I have been saying. In a conversation, you have a right to ask a question, then to answer it. But if you say you won‘ts answer any more, it means you don“t really want the answer. And you can bet that person will be very careful about what they say next.

Chinese New Year is celebrated in many ways in China. As the ancient Chinese believed that the first day of the year is always the most auspicious and the best time to make a new beginning, they celebrated Chinese New Years with great joy and enthusiasm.
However, Chinese people have been celebrating Chinese new years for thousands of years, and they have many different traditions and customs that are unique to Chinese culture. Chinese first celebrated the Chinese Lunar New year on January 25th, the day after the Spring Festival. This was the time when all the young men and women were supposed to get married and bring a good luck for the coming year. The most important aspect of Chinese tradition is the new moon. New moon is considered the symbol of new beginnings and new luck. And people are supposed not to spend money on new things and to take a break from work and family life. Therefore, people would try to avoid spending money and spend time with their family and friends. However, this is not always possible. On the other hand, on Chinese lunar New years people also celebrate the lunar new month, which is also called the Mid-Autumn Festival or the Lunyu Festival, Lun Yu Festival and Mid Autumn New Moon Festival in Chinese. People celebrate Lun New New in order to have good health, wealth and happiness. It is said that all Chinese have a dream and every dream has a different meaning. For example, a young girl might have her own child or a wealthy family will have their own home. To express the joy of having a happy new baby, many parents will decorate the house with balloons and toys. Many Chinese families also decorates the houses and have an early dinner to celebrate new birthdays, weddings, anniversaries and other holidays. Moreover, it is common to go to a public park to enjoy the weather and celebrate Chinese holidays in a fun and friendly way. In general, there are many Chinese traditions that people will celebrate during Chinese Mid Year New. But, some of them are much more popular and important than others. Some of these are the New Lun, New Pig, Mid Lun Lun Festival; Mid Spring Fair, Spring Flower Fair; New Month New Fish Festival etc. These are all important Chinese festivals that mark important events in the life of a Chinese person.

The federal government has its own banking system. The Federal Reserve System (FED) is the central bank of the United States. It was created by Congress in 1913 to "promote financial stability and the general welfare of its citizens." The FED is composed of 13 regional banks and 12 Federal reserve banks, which are located throughout the country.
In the 1920s, the Federal government began to borrow from the private banking industry to finance its expansion. However, during the Great Depression, private banks began limiting their lending, and Congress eventually passed the Emergency Banking Act of 1933, prohibiting the government from borrowing money from private financial institutions. This led to the creation of what is now called the "Emergency Liquidity Act" of 1934. Congress passed this act in order to keep the nation's banking institutions afloat and avoid a crisis. In 1941, Congress modified the Act to allow the U.S. government to hold short-term loans from other financial agencies. Over the next several years, this practice was expanded to include private companies, such as banks. After World War II, a series of new legislation allowed for a variety of government-sponsored enterprises to issue long- or shortterm, unsecured loans. These include the Economic Stabilization Act (1951), the Public Works Loan Act, (1953) and Public Buildings Loan and Improvement Act. (1956). The last of these acts, known as the Community Reinvestment Act was passed by the Congress to fund infrastructure projects. Later, in the 1960s and 1970s another series laws were passed to help finance the Vietnam War. With the end of World Wars II and Korea, these laws are no longer needed. While there have been numerous changes to these Acts since then, they remain a part of federal financial policy. As of June 30, 2015, there were over 1,300 of them in effect. An active or goal-directed learning strategy is one in which students actively participate in the learning process and seek to understand the material, make connections to other ideas, and apply what they learn. Active learning is more than just sitting in front of a computer and clicking on a mouse. It involves taking active steps to make sense of what is being presented.
A typical goal of an active learner is to use the information presented in a course to solve a problem. For example, if you are learning about a mathematical concept, an individual might try to apply the mathematical ideas to some real-world problem you might be faced with. Alternatively, the individual may try solving a math problem on their own, in their mind, without any input from an instructor. This is an example of how a student would use a concept learned in class. A typical active student is often motivated by a desire to increase their understanding of the subject, to learn more about it, use it in some practical way, explore it further, apply it to a new problem, etc. (Cohen, 1988)
Active learning has several characteristics:
1) The individual is responsible for the process. The student has to engage in active, self-guided learning, not passively follow the instructor's instructions. One of these characteristics is that the student must be able to actively take part in self and other directed learning. 2) An individual must have a strong desire for learning and take a positive approach to learning in general. 3) A student may need to take more time than most students do to complete a particular task. 4) Active students must not be afraid to ask questions of themselves or of other students. 5) There must also be the ability to relate to the teacher and to be accepted by the students in one's class 6) Students must use all the strategies they are taught to successfully complete the course. Some of those strategies are: 1) Studying the materials carefully 2), Reading the text carefully 3), Making connections between the concepts in learning 4), Applying the ideas in daily life 5), Communicating the results of their learning 6) Exploring new ideas 7) Using the skills they have learned to get their work done 8) Doing something constructive with their knowledge 9) Making their course assignments as well as their final assignments 10) Being able and willing to communicate their ideas and results to others 11) Learning to deal with failure and stress 12) Taking

Calcitonines are very similar to parathormone, and like parthormones, calcitons act on calcium-sensing receptors (CaSRs). They are not a hormone, but they are the hormones that act upon CaSR-containing cells. They work in a very specific way and in many different cells and tissues. The calcionins bind to the Ca2+ ions of the extracellular fluid and cause them to flow through the cell membrane into the cytoplasm, where they bind and activate the calcium channels. This causes a depolarization, which in turn causes the release of calcium from the endoplasmic reticulum and the mobilization of Ca into cells, for example in muscles. There, calcium is stored in cells until needed. In many tissues, the calcionsins also affect the smooth muscle, causing them, among other things, to contract. These actions lead to increased blood flow and muscle contraction. Most of these actions are important in controlling blood pressure. It is not known exactly how calcionesins affect blood vessels, nor how they change the blood vessel wall, although some calcionate effects are known. I was trying to find out what are the procedure code terms that are used in some codes. I have read a bit about procedure numbers, which are not very clear.
For example, for a procedure with code 2 and a number 1, I read that the number is the second procedure. Is this correct? I also read about procedures with numbers 1 and 2, 3 and 4, etc. What are these procedures? 
A:
addressing the question in a separate comment: 
In some countries, there are different ways of coding procedures. In the UK, the code for procedure 1 is called N/A, and procedure 2 is N. Procedure 3 is also called a N, procedure 4 is a P, procedures 5 and 6 are D. The codes for N and P are very close to each other, so you can say that they are both procedures 1. The code D is very different, but it is still a code (N/M) and so it should not be confused with the N in procedure number 2. So the general procedure coding system in the United Kingdom is N-D-N-P-1-M-2-4-5-6. 
 The procedure name is not always the same as the procedural code, e.g. N is for the National Health Service, M for medical procedure, P for psychiatric procedure and D for diagnostic procedure (e. g. CT scan). 
 To explain the procedures, you have to know the coding convention. For example if you are using the NHS coding, then the name of the system is NHS (National Health Services) which is followed by the numbering system, in this case NHS 1-7-8-9-10. This is how NHS codes are arranged. NHS code 1 relates to the first procedure you will perform in NHS. If you perform a second one (and it will be NHS 2), then NHS 3 will come after NHS1. And so on. You can find more information about the codes on the website of NHS England. (Note: NHS refers to National health services, not the British National NHS.)

 Procedure 1 - (1) (2) - Procedure 2 - D - N - M - P -

It's not really a question of "how" it's done, it is a very simple question, as it was asked by a student in my class. There is an answer, and it goes like this: The first thing is that the energy needed for the reaction is the same as the potential energy of the electrons in a chemical bond. Thus, when you have a certain amount of energy, you can "add" the electron, i.e. form a bond, which results in an energy increase.
There is one thing that I don't know how to explain in such a simple way, so I'll try to find it out. When you add an electron to a molecule, the molecule is not destroyed, but you also create a new bond between the two electronegative atoms of which it consists. So, in chemistry, this is called a double bond because it creates a "new" bond and a couple of electrons. The energy gained from this addition is just the difference in energy between a single bond (i. e. a non-bonded electron) and the single electron in "one" of these two atoms (the one with the double-electron). In the case of a carbon-carbon double, there are only two electrons, hence the name double. In general, a compound can contain more than one double (or more), in which case it has more bonds between its atoms, called multiplets. If the number of multiplet is odd, then it will be called an "octet". This is because the total number (4) of atoms in each molecule equals the even numbers (2n+1) in natural numbers. For example, if the first number is 2 and n is 6, that is (6)! = 2(2)! + 2 (1)(1)!. This means that there will always be two "n" multiplett molecules in any one molecule. I think this explains why the formula for energy is different from what is usually taught.

A calendar quarter is a collection of three or four months. The first calendar month of the year is the first quarter.
The second calendar months of each year are called the second quarter, the third quarter and so forth. Thus, in the current year, we have a calendar year that begins in January, and ends on December 31. We have 12 calendar quarters, which we call the quarters. In a year like 2019, for example, there are six quarters:
January through March April through June July through September October through December December through January February through April In a given year the calendar dates are the same for all quarters of that year. This year 2019 has the dates of January 1, March 1 and the date of December 25. These are all calendar days. However, they are not all dates in that same year; they do not repeat throughout the entire year!
What is important to understand is that the beginning of a quarter has no effect on the end of any quarter; the quarter begins on January first. For example: if you had a date, say January 2, 2019 (which is one day past the final day of March), and you wanted to know what the day was that quarter ended on, you could only determine that by adding the last day to March. If you were trying to determine the start of quarter 6, that would be March 3. You could not determine what quarter it ended in if the month did not begin on that day. (The same would happen if it began on another day.)
This is why the 12-quarter year (and the four-year year) are so useful. They are a way to measure the time that has elapsed since the previous year began. There is no need to worry about the exact date when you begin a new quarter in a certain year because you can count the days that have passed since you began the new year and determine when the next quarter began, without having to count any days again. It is just a matter of adding up the difference between the old and new years. And the twelve-month year allows you to do this, just like the other years of your life, by using the 365-day year as a reference. Hepatitis is a liver disease caused by the hepatitis C virus (HCV). It can affect almost anyone, but it's more common in people who are immune-suppressed, such as HIV patients. The virus is spread through blood or blood products, and can cause serious liver damage if it reaches the liver.
The number of people with the virus in the United States is estimated to be more than one million. People can get the disease if they have unprotected sexual intercourse with an infected person, or if their blood product is contaminated with blood from a person who has the infection. Most people infected with HCV do not know they are infected. Many people become infected while traveling or having close contact with infected people, especially intravenous drug users. About one in five people in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, South America, Australia, North America and South Africa get infected each year. In the US, 1 in 25 people gets infected in their lifetime. It's estimated that about 1.5 million people are living with hepatitis in this country. That number is likely to increase because of the use of blood and blood-products in medical and research applications. An estimated 6,500 people die from hepatitis each day, mostly in developing countries where it is more prevalent. Fortunately, most of these deaths are a result of getting infected by an injection drug user, rather than from cirrhosis. If you've ever had blood drawn, gotten a transfusion, had a tattoo, been in a bloodless sexual encounter or been infected through unsterilized medical equipment, you're at risk of hepatitis. Hepatocellular carcinoma is the most common type of cancer in those who get hepatitis and is one of six cancers linked to hepatitis virus infection that can be prevented. A vaccine that protects against hepatitis A and hepatitis B is also being developed.

A mortgage is a loan secured by a property and it’s collateral. It is used to finance the purchase of a home. The loan is made on the basis of the collateral value, the property.
The loan will be the balance in the bank account at the time of maturity. When the loan has been fully paid, it will close. This is when the mortgagee can take possession of your home and take it off your hands. However, if you are unable to meet the terms of repayment, you will have to pay back the amount that was loaned. These are the costs that the lender has to bear. If you cannot pay the monthly instalments, they can declare the entire amount as a default and they may go to auction. They will then sell your property for the highest bidder. You will still be entitled to your mortgage payments. There is also a penalty fee that will depend on your loan amount. In case you default, this will attract a higher penalty. For this reason, one should consider the fees before committing to a transaction. At times, lenders will refuse to lend on an unsecure property, as they don’t want to be in a situation where they cannot repay the debt. Therefore, before taking up the cash, make sure that your lender is able to secure your investment.

flour Cabbage, Carrots and Potato Bread Potato bread is the staple food of the southern United States. It is often made with mashed potatoes, but this recipe uses a potato puree instead. The result is a delicious potato-based bread that is not only gluten free, it also contains lots of fiber and is naturally lower in calories.
Serves 4-6 Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time : 1 hour Ingredients 1/2 cup masa harina 2 cups bread flour (not all-purpose)
½ cup tapioca flour, plus extra for kneading
¾ cup potato starch (optional) (or 1 cup water and 2 tablespoons cornstarch) - see note below for corn starch 3/4 tsp baking soda
¼ tsp salt pinch of cayenne pepper 4 cups water Directions For the potato:
Peel and grate the potatoes. Place in a large saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 20 minutes to cool slightly. Drain and mash with an immersion blender. Add the masala, salt, cumin, and onion. Mash again. Set aside. For the bread: In a food processor, combine the flour and potato mixture. Pulse just until combined. In another bowl, mix together the tapatioca starch, baking powder, the salt and cayan pepper. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture and mix until just combined and no lumps remain. If you are using corn starch, add it to the mixture after the final mixing. Transfer the dough to an oiled bowl and knead on a lightly floured surface. Cover with a damp kitchen towel and allow to rise in the bowl for 1-2 hours. Oil a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Divide the risen dough in half. Roll out each half into a 5x7 inch rectangle. Fold each rectangle in thirds to form a loaf. Spray the loaf with non-stick spray and place in loaf pans. Let rise for another 1 1/3-1 1 /2 hrs. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve hot or at room temperature. Notes: If using taperta and corn-starc, increase baking time to 1

So a bathe is the immersion of a person in a waterway or underground source of water (such as a fountain or spring) for cleansing purposes. A “waterway” may be a lake, stream or river. John says, "This is my beloved Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased." So baptism has always been considered to mean the washing of feet. 
It is worth noting that baptism was an ancient rite of purification performed by priests. Today, it is performed in many Christian churches. Baptism was performed for adults by washing the hands and feet as well as anointing the head, and was a sign of repentance and faith.

Human sperm is composed of two components: a fluid outer coat called “cumulus cells” and a protein-rich inner layer called the “zona pellucida”. The zona is a small membrane-like structure which surrounds the sperm and is responsible for the release of sperm from the female reproductive tract, and also for fertilization.
The fluid coat is made of a mixture of water, lipids, electrolytes, proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins, anti-oxidants, hormones, antibodies and other elements. The fluid coats the surface of the spermatozoa, protecting them from various external threats. Spermatozoa are not only protected from outside threats, but also from inside threats which are the most common in the male reproductive system. These are:
– Chemicals and physical agents which can be used by the body to destroy or kill the cells Sperm cells can withstand a lot of damage, for example, when the cell is damaged by a chemical or physical agent, the DNA in it is protected by histones. It is the histone that binds with other proteins and prevents the protein from breaking down. If the binding is broken, it can result in cancer or death. In this way, sperm cells, which were damaged in a natural way are now protected. Also, damaged sperm can have their DNA damaged, so the chromosomes are no longer able to pass on their information to the next generation. As a result, a baby is born with a genetically damaged chromosome. This causes a serious problem when trying to have children. However, because of this protection, human sperm have a very long life span. Even after fertilization, they are able for up to 40 years, after which time the level of DNA damage increases and the ability to fertilize decreases. Therefore, there is no need for artificial insemination. That is why there are many people who can’t have kids. They are unable to get pregnant or have any success at it. For this reason, artificial fertilization is also not used in assisted reproduction. Only in rare cases, such as in cases of severe male infertility, is it used to produce healthy children after several years of infertility treatment.

28 U.S.C. § 2680(c)(3).
Section 2640(e) provides that the "individual who is the subject of an exclusion or a prohibition, or whose rights are restricted by such an exclusions, prohibitions, limitations, conditions, reservations, rights, duties, restrictions, terms, waivers, authorizations, and/or immunities, shall not be entitled to bring an action for the recovery of such exclusion, prohibition or limitation, nor shall the United States be liable for such action or for any damages for which the individual is liable under the law of the place where the conduct that gave rise to the exclusion occurs." 28 U S C §2640. It is clear, therefore, that as a matter of federal law, the Secretary of State is not a party to a suit to recover property that is lost through negligence, but, rather, only the private party is a proper defendant. 28 C.F.R. §§ 14.2(a), 14(d)(2)(v). Likewise, an individual cannot be an "individual company", as the term is used in law. In some jurisdictions, for example in Switzerland, companies can have a name, but that name cannot refer directly to any individual or to an association of individuals. Instead, it refers specifically to companies as entities, even if the individuals that compose them are not individuals or entities themselves, e.g. the shareholders of a bank. Therefore, although the law in one jurisdiction does not usually distinguish between the use of "corporation" and "partnership", in others it does. "Renaissance" is the name of a style of art that emerged in the mid-sixteenth century, and its first great exponent was Michelangelo. Renaissance is also the title of an essay by the historian David Hume, who also wrote of the first half of that century.
In English, the term Renaissance comes from the Italian Renaissance, as in Renaissance painting. In English Renaissance the Renaissance style is considered the best in art, architecture, poetry, music, drama, literature, sculpture, etc. (see Renascence).
The term "renaissance" has been used to describe the style, but is used less often in English than in other languages. For example, in French it is called renascent, while in German it's called das Renaissancetrennen, which literally means "the Renaissance of men."
Renaiscence is a noun, not a verb, so it can't be used in a sentence. It's always followed by a preposition: "in that style." The prepositions are usually: and, or, of, by, from, among, to, for, with, at, about, over, below, on, against, beside, under, between, above, before, after, around, behind, next to. The noun is always plural, like the noun Renaissance. There's no such thing as "a Renaissance man," only "men who have a Renaissance attitude towards life." 
You can also use the phrase "Renéissance" in reference to a specific style or movement, such as the Baroque, Gothic, Rococo, Barbizon, Pre-Raphaelite, Art Nouveau, Neo-classical, Modernist, Post-Modernist.
